limited_scopes.description:
Available scopes (when scope_type = limited). Select one or more values:

| Scope | Description |
|--------|-----------|
| `admin.subaccounts` | Manage subaccounts of the main account |
| `admin.users` | Manage users and permissions |
| `automation.email_accounts` | Manage email accounts for automation |
| `automation.email_deliveries` | View and manage email deliveries |
| `automation.sms_accounts` | Manage SMS accounts |
| `automation.sms_deliveries` | View and manage SMS deliveries |
| `automation.webhook_deliveries` | View and manage webhook deliveries |
| `automation.webhooks` | Manage webhooks and automated notifications |
| `billing.transactions` | View billing and charging transactions |
| `charge.automatic_pix.locations` | Manage automatic Pix locations |
| `charge.automatic_pix.pix` | Manage automatic Pix charges |
| `charge.automatic_pix.recurrences` | Manage automatic Pix recurrences |
| `charge.automatic_pix.requests` | Manage automatic Pix requests |
| `charge.bank_billet_accounts` | Manage bank boleto accounts |
| `charge.bank_billet_payments` | View and register boleto payments |
| `charge.bank_billet_registrations` | Manage boleto registrations at banks |
| `charge.bank_billets` | Manage bank boletos |
| `charge.customer_subscriptions` | Manage customer subscriptions |
| `charge.installments` | Manage installments |
| `charge.payments` | View and manage received payments |
| `charge.pix` | Manage Pix charges |
| `charge.pix_accounts` | Manage Pix accounts |
| `core.providers` | View available providers |
| `crm.customers` | Manage customers and business information |
| `crm.people` | Manage people and contacts |
| `data.bank_billet_queries` | Query bank boleto information |
| `financial.accounts` | Manage financial accounts |
| `financial.balances` | View balances and financial movements |
| `financial.providers` | Manage financial providers and banking integrations |
| `financial.statement_transactions` | View transactions and financial statements |
| `integration.certificates` | Manage digital certificates for integrations |
| `integration.connections` | Manage connections with banks and providers |
| `integration.discharges` | Manage banking return files (discharges) |
| `integration.edi_boxes` | Manage EDI mailboxes for file exchange |
| `integration.remittances` | Manage banking remittance files |
| `mailbox.entries` | Manage mailboxes for receiving files |
| `mailbox.files` | View and manage files in mailboxes |
| `partner.bank_contracts` | Manage banking contracts with partners |
| `payment.accounts` | Manage payment accounts (including EDI remittance enablement) |
| `payment.bank_billets` | Make bank boleto payments |
| `payment.batches` | Manage payment batches |
| `payment.dda_accounts` | Manage DDA accounts |
| `payment.dda.bank_billets` | Manage DDA boletos |
| `payment.darfs` | Make DARF payments (federal taxes) |
| `payment.payments` | Manage all types of payments through the API |
| `payment.pix` | Make payments via Pix |
| `payment.taxes` | Make tax and fee payments |
| `payment.utilities` | Make utility bill payments (water, electricity, etc) |
| `security.access_tokens` | Manage access tokens and authentication |
| `system.events` | View system events and logs |
| `system.imports` | Manage data imports |
| `system.reports` | Generate and view system reports |
| `transfer.accounts` | Manage transfer accounts (including EDI remittance enablement) |
| `transfer.batches` | Manage transfer batches |
| `transfer.internal` | Perform internal transfers between accounts |
| `transfer.pix` | Perform transfers via Pix |
| `transfer.ted` | Perform TED transfers |
| `transfer.transfers` | Manage all types of transfers (Pix, TED, Internal) via unified endpoint |

expires_at.description: Expiration date (maximum 1 year). **Attention:** Can only be set if it was not already set. Once set, it cannot be changed again.

body.description: Information of the access token to be changed.
